entries.publisher: Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources and Forestry

intendedRole.en: Ontario forest-resource inventory context for the published Term 2 range. No open bulk endpoint was found, so this remains a discovery record.
intendedRole.fr: Contexte de l’inventaire des ressources forestières de l’Ontario pour la période publiée du terme 2. Aucun point de téléchargement en bloc ouvert n’a été trouvé, donc cet enregistrement reste au stade de la découverte.

verifiedFacts: Official catalogue identifies Term 2 as covering 2018–2028.
Catalogue identifies a GeoHub web resource, says update as required, and states Open Government Licence – Ontario.
The data.ontario.ca record carries exactly two resources, both of format WEB, being the English and French GeoHub explore pages. It carries no data resource of any downloadable format.

The English GeoHub resource resolves to ArcGIS Online item ca6def13e17540deb6e91d81e9cb2c89, whose type is Web Map and whose item url field is empty. A Web Map is a map document and exposes no data download endpoint.
A HEAD request on the GeoHub explore URL returned HTTP 200 with Content-Type text/html, which is the explorer page and not a data payload.
The Web Map's only operational layers are a Forest Management Unit boundary service and a Romeo Malette Forest boundary service. Neither carries Term 2 forest stand polygons.

The FRI Packaged Product Catalogue table at LIO_Open07 MapServer layer 24 lists 94 packaged products, but their inventory vintages run from 1995 to 2011 and the rows carry bare file names with no base URL.

The Forest Resources Inventory Packaged Products Version 2 item lists 78 direct ZIP links on ws.gisetl.lrc.gov.on.ca whose inventory vintages run from 2007 to 2016, so every one predates the 2018 start of Term 2. A HEAD request on one of them returned HTTP 200, Content-Type application/zip and Content-Length 210935203, confirming the host serves data and that the absence of Term 2 packages is a real gap rather than a broken host.

The documented access route for Ontario forest cover data is a request form at https://forms.office.com/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=KRLczSqsl0u3ig5crLWGXNa0411DWIhEm5hXfTKiiaZUOFEyUVBaRzdLU1ZTTEZYMzFXQzIzNEhHRCQlQCN0PWcu and the contact address info.mnrfscience@ontario.ca published on https://www.ontario.ca/page/forest-resources-inventory.

The catalogue states the Term 2 packaged products are draft data provided for consultation and product development, that attributes and formats will change, and that they should not be treated as a final version.
The Forest Cover item attaches an Electronic Intellectual Property notice from the ministry rather than the Open Government Licence, so the licence covering a released Term 2 package is not settled.
unresolvedFields: Whether any open Term 2 bulk endpoint exists, because none was found
Which licence governs a released Term 2 package given the Electronic Intellectual Property notice
